description: KP Dasha Interpretation Rules — Mahadasha and Antardasha period predictions

rules.prediction: Sun Mahadasha brings focus on career, authority, and recognition. Government connections strengthen. Father's health or relationship becomes prominent. Ego conflicts possible. Good for leadership roles.

Sun-Moon period brings emotional sensitivity alongside career ambitions. Public recognition possible. Mother's health or relationship highlighted. Mind and ego may conflict. Good for public-facing roles.
Sun-Mars period is energetic and action-oriented. Career advancement through bold moves. Property matters active. Possible conflicts with authority. Good for sports, military, engineering.

Sun-Rahu period brings sudden changes in career and status. Foreign connections emerge. Unconventional opportunities arise. Ego challenges from unexpected sources. Technology or foreign career possible.

Sun-Jupiter is one of the most auspicious periods. Wisdom, fortune, and career success combine. Teaching, law, or advisory roles flourish. Children and marriage matters are positive. Spiritual growth.
Sun-Saturn creates tension between authority and discipline. Career obstacles and delays. Hard work required for recognition. Father-son conflicts possible. Health of bones/joints may be affected.
Sun-Mercury brings intellectual sharpness and communication skills. Business, writing, and education flourish. Short travels for career. Good for IT, media, and commerce.
Sun-Ketu brings spiritual inclination and detachment from material pursuits. Past karma surfaces. Sudden events in career. Research and occult interests emerge.
Sun-Venus brings luxury, romance, and artistic pursuits alongside career. Marriage matters active. Creative fields flourish. Good for arts and entertainment.
Moon Mahadasha is emotionally intense. Public life and popularity increase. Mother's health prominent. Mind is active and changeable. Good for hospitality, public service, and real estate.

Mars Mahadasha brings energy, courage, and action. Property matters active. Sibling relationships highlighted. Possible accidents or surgeries if Mars afflicted. Good for sports, military, engineering.
Mars-Venus brings passion, romance, and creative energy. Marriage matters active if both signify 2,7,11. Property purchase possible. Arts and luxury flourish.
Mars-Jupiter is highly auspicious for career, wealth, and wisdom. Property gains. Children matters positive. Legal matters resolve favorably. Good for leadership and expansion.
Mars-Saturn is one of the most challenging periods. Conflicts, obstacles, and delays. Accidents possible. Hard work with little reward. Patience required.

Rahu Mahadasha brings sudden and dramatic life changes. Foreign connections and unconventional paths emerge. Technology and innovation flourish. Obsessive tendencies. Illusions and deceptions possible.

Rahu-Jupiter brings expansion through unconventional wisdom. Foreign education or spiritual growth. Career advancement through networking. Marriage possible if both signify 2,7,11. Generally positive.
Rahu-Saturn is one of the most challenging combinations. Sudden losses, delays, and obstacles. Health challenges. Career setbacks. Foreign-related problems. Requires extreme patience.
Rahu-Mercury brings sharp intellect and communication skills. Technology and IT careers flourish. Business opportunities through foreign connections. Writing and media success.
Rahu-Venus brings intense romantic experiences and luxury. Marriage possible if both signify 2,7,11. Foreign romantic connections. Arts and entertainment flourish.
Rahu-Sun brings sudden career opportunities and recognition. Government connections through unconventional means. Ego conflicts with authority. Foreign career possible.
Rahu-Moon brings emotional turbulence and mental restlessness. Public life changes suddenly. Mother's health highlighted. Possible anxiety or mood swings. Travel to foreign lands.
Rahu-Mars brings sudden energy and aggression. Property matters active. Accidents possible. Career changes through bold unconventional moves. Conflicts with siblings.
Rahu-Ketu brings spiritual crisis and material-spiritual conflict. Past karma surfaces strongly. Sudden losses and detachment. Mystical experiences.

Jupiter Mahadasha is generally the most auspicious period. Wisdom, fortune, and expansion in all areas. Marriage, children, and career all benefit. Spiritual growth. Teaching and advisory roles flourish.

Jupiter-Venus is highly auspicious for marriage, romance, and luxury. Career in arts or luxury sectors flourishes. Children matters positive. Financial gains. One of the best periods for relationships.
Jupiter-Jupiter is the most auspicious sub-period. Maximum fortune, wisdom, and expansion. Marriage, children, career all at peak. Spiritual growth. Divine grace. Major positive life events.
Jupiter-Saturn brings disciplined expansion. Hard work leads to lasting success. Career stability. Property gains through patience. Spiritual discipline. Slower but solid progress.
Jupiter-Mercury brings intellectual wisdom and communication success. Education, writing, and business flourish. Good for teaching, law, and advisory roles.
Saturn Mahadasha is the longest and most karmic period. Hard work, discipline, and patience are tested. Delays in all matters. Career through service and perseverance. Spiritual lessons.
Saturn-Venus brings delayed but lasting romantic relationships. Marriage possible if both signify 2,7,11. Career in arts or luxury with discipline. Financial stability through hard work.
Saturn-Jupiter brings disciplined wisdom and slow but steady expansion. Career stability. Spiritual growth through discipline. Property gains through patience.
Saturn-Mercury brings disciplined intellect and methodical communication. Technical and analytical work flourishes. Business through hard work. Research and analysis succeed.
Saturn-Saturn is the most karmic sub-period. Maximum delays and restrictions. Hard work with slow rewards. Major life lessons. Patience is the only path.
Mercury Mahadasha brings intellectual sharpness and communication success. Business, education, and writing flourish. Short travels. Good for IT, media, commerce, and teaching.
Mercury-Venus brings creative communication and romantic expression. Arts, media, and entertainment flourish. Marriage matters active if both signify 2,7,11.
Mercury-Jupiter is excellent for education, wisdom, and business expansion. Teaching and advisory roles flourish. Legal matters resolve favorably. Financial gains through intellect.
Mercury-Mercury is peak intellectual period. Communication, education, and business at maximum. Multiple opportunities in media, IT, and commerce. Adaptability and wit are strongest.
Venus Mahadasha is the longest and often most enjoyable period. Love, beauty, luxury, and comfort dominate. Marriage and relationships flourish. Arts and entertainment careers peak.
Venus-Venus is the most luxurious and romantic sub-period. Marriage highly likely if Venus signifies 2,7,11. Arts and entertainment at peak. Financial gains. Very positive.
Venus-Mercury brings creative communication and business in luxury or arts. Marriage matters active. Education in arts or design. Good for media, fashion, and entertainment.
Venus-Jupiter is highly auspicious. Marriage, children, and luxury all peak. Career in arts or luxury with wisdom. Financial gains. Spiritual beauty. One of the best sub-periods.
Venus-Saturn brings disciplined romance and delayed luxury. Marriage with maturity and commitment. Career in arts through hard work. Financial stability. Relationships become serious.
Venus-Rahu brings unconventional romance and luxury. Foreign romantic connections. Sudden relationship changes. Arts and technology combine. Exciting but potentially unstable.
Venus-Moon brings emotional romance and public popularity. Marriage matters very active. Mother's health positive. Real estate gains. Public-facing creative roles flourish.
Venus-Mars brings passionate romance and energetic creativity. Property gains. Marriage possible with intensity. Good for sports, arts, and property.
Venus-Sun brings creative authority and recognition in arts. Career in entertainment or luxury. Government roles in creative fields. Father's health highlighted.
Venus-Ketu brings spiritual detachment from luxury and romance. Past karma in relationships. Mystical beauty. Some material losses but spiritual gains. Introspection in relationships.
Ketu Mahadasha brings spiritual inclination and detachment from material world. Past karma resolves. Sudden events and losses. Research and occult flourish. Isolation and introspection.
